capabilities: Render ruby annotations in reading and editing modes
Look up readings and meanings of Japanese expressions
Build, reorder and sort a glossary panel
Convert between Markdown and HTML ruby syntaxes
extras: PolyForm-Perimeter license; zero run-time dependencies; internet needed only to download or update dictionary data; install instructions are a link to external docs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in support for Japanese reading annotations, dictionary lookup of kanji words, or glossary building, so these tasks need outside tools.
